Karen offers a selection of powerful modalities—Reiki for deep energetic restoration, Akashic Record Readings for soul-level insight, and Aura Imaging for a visual reflection of your energy field and chakra balance. events.title: Amber | Customized Therapeutic Massage Sessions
events.description: Amber offers a deeply restorative, results-driven massage experience tailored to meet your body exactly where it is. Blending Swedish, Thai, Deep Tissue, and Warm Bamboo techniques, each session is intuitively customized—designed to release tension, improve mobility, and bring your body back into balance. Amber offers a range of healing touch therapies within each session, including Deep Tissue for releasing chronic tension and stubborn knots, Thai Massage for assisted stretching, energy flow, and full-body reset, Swedish Massage for gentle relaxation and nervous system support, and restorative bodywork that helps the body unwind on a deeper level. Warm bamboo tools may be incorporated to enhance circulation and deliver more effective muscle release. Her work not only addresses physical tension, but can also support the release of stored stress and trauma held within the body—helping clients feel more grounded, at ease, and reconnected. Each session is created with care, skill, and presence—leaving clients feeling restored, lighter, and profoundly relieved. 30-minute chair sessions ($60) are ideal for quick relief—perfect for neck, shoulders, and upper back tension. 45-minute sessions ($90) allow for more focused therapeutic work, addressing specific areas of tightness or stress. 60-minute sessions ($125) offer a full-body experience, combining relaxation and targeted muscle release. 90-minute sessions ($166) provide the most comprehensive treatment—supporting deeper release, full-body integration, and lasting results. When booking, please select your session length. Your massage style and focus will be customized during your appointment.

events.title: Ankh Lifeforce Alignment Reiki with Rose
events.description: Ankh Life Force Alignment Those who know Rose know that the spaces she creates are unlike any other. There is a quiet reverence, a sense of peace, and a palpable sacredness that begins the moment you enter the room. This next evolution of her practice is an invitation to experience the gifts of her journey—and perhaps awaken something that has always been waiting within you. After a profound journey through Egypt, Rose returned home with a deepened connection to her healing work. Immersed in the energy of ancient temples & pyramids, timeless spiritual traditions, and the enduring symbolism of the Ankh—the Key of Life—she came home carrying something that is difficult to put into words. Some experiences are learned. Others are remembered. The wisdom, presence, and sacredness Rose encountered have naturally woven themselves into the healing practice she has lovingly cultivated for years. Through Reiki, crystals, tuning forks, healing sound, sacred oils, and the symbolism of the Ankh, she creates a deeply intentional space where healing is invited, balance is restored, and the spirit is gently supported.

events.title: Sacred Stillness: A Women’s Circle for Meditation, Reflection & Connection
events.description: Sacred Stillness is a welcoming women’s circle created as a space to slow down, turn inward, and reconnect—with yourself and with a supportive community of women. Each gathering offers an opportunity to step away from the demands and noise of everyday life and simply be. Through guided meditation, intentional reflection, meaningful conversation, and gentle practices for grounding and self-connection, we create space to listen more deeply to ourselves and honor whatever we may be carrying or moving through. Each month explores a different theme, offering a fresh invitation for personal reflection, growth, release, or renewal. While the focus changes from gathering to gathering, the heart of Sacred Stillness remains the same: a safe, supportive space where women can gather without pressure, expectation, or the need to have anything figured out. No meditation experience or spiritual background is necessary. Come exactly as you are. ✨ Sacred Stillness is an invitation to pause, breathe, connect, and remember that sometimes the most meaningful thing we can do is simply make space to listen within. Group session · attendance limit 25

events.title: Wings & Kids Wizardry: A Real Life Owl Adventure
events.description: Step into a world of wizardry where owls deliver magic, wishes take flight, and every young wizard leaves with an owl of their very own! Join us for an unforgettable magical adventure featuring a LIVE OWL, enchanting games, sweet treats, spellbinding activities, and a very special Wishes Taking Flight Ceremony. 🦉 WINGS, WISHES & WIZARDRY 🪄 Young witches and wizards are invited to Sacred Ground for an afternoon where imagination, magic, and the mysterious world of owls come together! We’ll begin with an up-close LIVE OWL presentation, where kids will meet one of these incredible creatures, learn fascinating owl facts, enjoy magical treats and drinks, and have the opportunity for photos with our feathered guest. Then the wizardry begins! Each child will take part in a magical Sorting Hat experience to discover which special owl has chosen them. And yes—every participant gets to take their little owl home! But first, their owl needs a name…and a little magic. Using selenite, each young wizard will name and “activate” their owl, creating a magical companion to carry their wishes, dreams, and intentions. Throughout our adventure, kids will enjoy wizard-inspired games and activities, including a fun Quidditch-style releasing activity where we’ll practice the magic of letting go of something we no longer want to carry. Next, we’ll create Feather Wishes Scrolls, writing down the wishes and dreams we’d most love to send out into the universe. And for our grand finale… ✨ WISHES TAKING FLIGHT ✨ Together, we’ll gather for a special ceremony where our young wizards will release their wishes and send a little magic out into the world. Every child leaves with their own owl, their magical experience, and hopefully the feeling that sometimes the most powerful magic begins with a wish. 🦉 Live Owl Presentation 🪄 Wizardry & Magical Games 🎩 Sorting Hat Owl Assignment ✨ Name & Activate Your Owl with Selenite 🪶 Feather Wishes Scrolls 🌟 Wishes Taking Flight Ceremony 🍪 Magical Treats & Drinks 📸 Photos with the Live Owl 🦉 A Little Owl for Every Child to Take Home Space is intentionally limited so every young wizard can be part of the magic. Group Experience Maximum 14 Participants Grab your cloak, bring your imagination, and come ready for a little mischief, a little magic…and a whole lot of owl wizardry.
